prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Selectively describe nearby platforms, trunks, foliage and railings, with distant trees and structures progressively lighter and simpler in soft atmospheric depth. No orange, peach, yellow or tan wash: use the same pale paper tone as the approved series. No colored paint, thick brushwork, watercolor wash, heavy black ink masses, photorealism, glossy digital rendering or 3D. Wide 16:9 full-bleed landscape, intended final export 2560x1440. No writing, readable runes, lettering, labels, captions, map symbols, decorative border, frame, blank bottom strip, black bars, watermark or UI.
